tasks.message: Save a test agent 'golden-echo' (haiku, 3 turns, $0.50 ceiling, direct channel, no repositories) whose instructions are to answer in one sentence, run it once and read back the agent and the run. Use our own dev/test Enact stack at https://$PRISM_DOMAIN with the shared key in PRISM_API_KEY (already set in your environment); send X-Source-Repository and X-Source-Commit on every write, then read the configuration back through the API and show that it matches what you wrote.

must_include: the configuration read back through the Enact HTTP API, matching what was written
X-Source-Repository and X-Source-Commit sent on the write
run id, status, turns, tokens and cost
which model credential the run used
must_not: uses AWS credentials or the AWS CLI
writes to the soofi-safavi or any production environment
reports a check as passing that it did not run
prints a secret, API key or token value
